items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's statement about Tommy with 'Nobody was Tommy' and later discusses his own family naming conventions ('they probably called me Alvin'). There is no direct statement from the interviewee describing a personal relationship with Tommy.

ctx.x: No, cause, Tommy originally told, told me that, and he was coming up, he was small, all his family called him Thomas. Nobody called him Tom. Tommy. Or Tommy.
Not till he was, he was, he was much older. Mm-hmm. They called him Tommy. And I've always called him Tommy. Mm-hmm. Never called him Thomas. Yeah. It seemed, it seemed kind of formal.
